title: Seismic fragility of a long-span RC deck arch bridge under three-component and spatially varying ground motion: data and scripts
description: Ground-motion record list with scale factors (S1), peak responses of all nonlinear time-history analyses (S2), fragility parameters with exceedance counts (S3) and the OpenSeesPy analysis scripts (S4) for the Cetina arch bridge fragility study.
